plot_summary: Dawei Shen is the protagonist. On Sunday, December 1, 2024 at 8 pm, self, Charles Wilde, Vickie Lee, Francis Wagner were involved. Dawei messages Charles and Vickie on WhatsApp to confirm theater rehearsal, and Francis shares a Google Doc with schedule updates. Vickie says she will be 20 minutes late and apologizes. Francis emails the doc to the group.
user_goal: You cannot attend the rehearsal tonight due to a medical emergency and have to reschedule for the following day.       You send an email to everyone in the rehearsal group confirming this and create a new calendar event for the following day 2-December-2024 and invite them.

success_conditions.input_text: 1. An email message saying "I apologise for this guys but I wont be able to attend tonight's rehearsal as I'm extremely unwell, I've rescheduled the rehearsal for tomorrow. Calendar event to follow" is created at 01-12-2024 at 20:10.
2. A Calendar event is created called "Rescheduled Theatre Rehearsal" for 02-12-2024 at 21:00 to 22:00. Charles Wilde, Vickie Lee and Francis Wagner are the invitees.
3. The creation time recorded on the new entry is at or after the reference time, i.e. it is not backdated.
